dedupe_keys.name: university of michigan cnc milling tool wear experiments

description: Sharon Sun publishes this dataset from the University of Michigan System-level Manufacturing and Automation Research Testbed, hosted on Kaggle. It contains eighteen CNC experiments cutting an S-shaped feature in wax blocks, varying tool condition, feed rate and clamping pressure. A summary CSV identifies experimental settings, worn or unworn tools, inspection outcome and machining completion. Separate experiment CSVs provide 100 ms measurements from the X, Y, Z and spindle motors. Coverage is the SMART laboratory machine and test pieces; acquisition dates are not stated. The provider proposes tool-wear classification and detecting inadequate clamping or safety-related stops, establishing a condition monitoring role. Eight experiments used unworn tools and ten used worn tools. CC0 terms are stated; reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that some variables are known to misrepresent machine operation under specified feed-rate, position or program-number conditions, with the cause unresolved. No files were downloaded or models run.
